name: Cycles without clumps: A coreless étale correspondence in characteristic two
abstract: A symmetric degree-25 finite étale self-correspondence of a genus-two curve in characteristic two. It is minimal and coreless, has no nonempty finite clump, and its generic graph contains K5,5. Connected cyclic base changes preserve minimality under the stated coprimality conditions; diagonal base changes remain symmetric, while mixed-endpoint examples may have different genera.
